purpose: Requirements for the agenda display layer that generates human-readable presentations from the agenda record, giving overview, change visibility, and consistency with the record.
summary: Overview: separating display from storage to avoid boundary collisions in human text
Terminology follows the agenda record requirements; no new terms
Scope: presentation generated from records, overview, change visibility, consistency
Out of scope: storage, state management, timing of presentation, presentation etiquette, content correctness
FNC-001: one agenda shows all items, states, remaining count, including withdrawn items
FNC-002: changes from the last update are distinguishable
FNC-003/004: presentation generated from record; no AI direct writing; AI need not read presentations
FNC-005: direct access to an item by its identifier
NFR-001: presentation reads as a generated artifact
TBD-001 resolved: HTML adopted as the presentation format
tasks: Designing or implementing the agenda HTML display
Changing how consult presents agenda items
Writing tests for agenda presentation generation
title: REQ-021 agenda 表示層 要件定義書
